full_judgment:
Gour Gopal Saha, J: This rule is directed against the judgment and decree dated 15.5.2002 passed by the Additional District Judge, Kurigram in Other Appeal No. 59 of 2000 allowing the appeal on reversing the judgment and decree dated 3.4.2000 passed by the Joint District Judge in Charge, 1st Court, Kurigram in Other Class Suit No. 8 of 1992 decreeing the suit. 

 5. The learned Subordinate Judge by his impugned judgment dated 3.4.2000 decreed the suit on contest allotting a saham for 8 decimals of land to the plaintiff. 

 6. Being aggrieved by the aforesaid impugned judgment and decree dated 3.4.2000 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, Kurigram the contesting defendant took an appeal before the District Judge, Kurigram being Other Class Appeal No. 59 of 2000. 

 7. The learned Additional District Judge who heard the appeal, has been pleased by the impugned Judgment and decree dated 15.5.2002 to allow the appeal on reversing the judgment and decree passed by the learned trial Court. 

 12. In the result, the rule is discharged without any order as to costs and the impugned judgment and decree dated 15.5.2002 passed by the learned Additional Districts Judge, Kurigram in Other Class Appeal No. 59 of 2000 reversing the judgment and decree dated 3.4.2000 passed by the learned Joint District Judge- in- Charge of the 1st Court, Kurigram in Other Class Suit No. 8 of 1992 decreeing the suit are set aside.
